free_tier.stated: Named by a live stock-and-price tracker as the cheapest H100 PCIe offer with stock on 2026-10-22: H100 PCIe 80GB at USD 2.59 per GPU-hour, across five providers that report stock on that model. The tracker counts 20,068 configurations from 31 providers, reads secure on-demand listings only, and requires a stock observation within 15 minutes of its refresh.

record.interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
record.chaining: A 2.59 PCIe H100 undercuts the USD 3.29 H100 median and is close to the USD 2.27 preemptible H100 on Daytona, but with no preemption penalty if the listing is a secure offer.

record.binding_note: Binding constraints beyond published rates are unconfirmed in available documentation.

quoted method: 'All figures are the cheapest current secure on-demand price per GPU-hour tracked by GPUPerHour, excluding spot and peer-to-peer marketplace listings', 31 providers and 20,068 configurations, stock observation within 15 minutes

record.notes: It is recorded because the PCIe part sits between the two well-covered shapes, a 1.80 PCIe H100 at HyperAI and a 2.73 SXM H100 at Massed Compute, and a session pricing a PCIe H100 otherwise has no third point. The tracker's own caveat applies: an offer count is a count of configurations, not of physical GPUs.
